content.value:
In a particular display system the maximum size of the matrix 30 × 30 and (08)   
420 × 420 is used for twisted nematic and STN liquid crystal cells,   
respectively. Calculate the value of P for each of the liquid crystal cell, when   
cells are addressed by passive matrix addressing system.
